concepts.learning_objective: Compute the average velocity of a moving body over a time interval from its distance-time relation.
Explain instantaneous velocity as the limiting value of average velocities over shrinking intervals.

topics.title: Limits: left hand and right hand limits

concepts.learning_objective: Find the left hand and right hand limits of a function at a point.
Decide whether the limit of a function exists at a point by comparing one-sided limits.

topics.title: Algebra of limits; limits of polynomials and rational functions

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the sum, product and quotient rules for limits with their conditions.
Evaluate limits of polynomial and rational functions, including 0/0 forms by factorisation.
Use the result that the limit of (x^n - a^n)/(x - a) as x tends to a is n a^(n-1).
State and apply the Sandwich Theorem for limits.
Evaluate limits using lim sin x/x = 1 and lim (1 - cos x)/x = 0 as x tends to 0.
Define the derivative at a point as a limit and interpret it as the slope of the tangent.
Find derivatives of simple functions from the first principle.

topics.title: Algebra of derivatives; derivatives of polynomials and trigonometric functions

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the sum, product (Leibnitz) and quotient rules of differentiation.
Differentiate polynomials and sin x, cos x using standard results.
